atomic_facts.fact: Because it was dissolved on 2020-09-03, Wirecard AG could not have existed to report fiscal year 2023 revenue.
As of December 21, 2023, Wirecard AG was listed as participating in insolvency proceedings.
Those insolvency proceedings were ongoing in Germany.
Wirecard AG filed for insolvency proceedings.
Wirecard AG did not publish or file financial statements for fiscal year 2023.
Wirecard AG's insolvency status was the reason it did not publish or file financial statements for fiscal year 2023.
